name: dev-flow-orchestrator
description: Complete, resumable personal delivery workflows for one Git repository in Codex on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Runs one V6 controller on macOS with six declarative personal-delivery workflows, structured contracts, typed artifact lineage, bounded assurance rework, optional driver fallbacks, and terminal Delivery Dossiers. Each task pins its exact workflow while state remains outside the target repository.
defaultPrompt: Start a V6 personal-delivery workflow for this repository.
Resume the active V6 workflow from its saved projection.
Continue this task through its final Delivery Dossier.
